articles.title: Meta signs three nuclear power deals to help support its AI data centers
articles.mainIdea: Meta signs three nuclear power deals to help support its AI data centers
articles.summary: Associated Press Finance: Meta signs three nuclear power deals to help support its AI data centers. Facebook parent Meta has reached nuclear power deals with three companies as it continues to look for electricity sources for its artificial intelligence data centers. Meta struck agreements with TerraPower, Oklo and Vistra for nuclear power for its Prometheus AI data center that is being built in New Albany, Ohio. Meta announced Prometheus, which will be a 1-gigawatt cluster spanning across multiple data center buildings, in July. Related tickers mentioned: CEG, OKLO, OPAI.PVT, VST.

articles.title: Meta Signs Multi-Gigawatt Nuclear Deals for AI Data Centers
articles.mainIdea: Meta Signs Multi-Gigawatt Nuclear Deals for AI Data Centers
articles.summary: Bloomberg: Meta Signs Multi-Gigawatt Nuclear Deals for AI Data Centers. The agreements could end up totaling more than 6 gigawatts, enough to power a city of about 5 million homes. While Meta didn’t disclose the value of the contracts, agreements of this size can easily represent billions of dollars in total revenue for electricity generators. Meta said Friday it will purchase electricity from three existing Vistra Corp. plants and support several small reactors that Sam Altman-backed Oklo Inc. and Bill Gates-backed TerraPower LLC are planning to build over the next decade. Related tickers mentioned: CEG, OKLO, VST.
